_comment: jarvis-kit: generic example manifest for check-skill-approval.mjs; the entry is fictional and its hash is a placeholder. One entry per skill directory. sha256 = sha256 over the sorted lines '<relpath>\0<sha256 of file bytes>' joined by '\n'. Add or change an entry ONLY on the owner's approval of that exact text, and name the decision in 'approved'. Generate an entry with: node check-skill-approval.mjs --hash skills/<name>
